wn.name: WaterCraft
wn.numbers: Wixii halkan ku jira waa caawimo xisaab. Injineer biyaha ayaa hubin kasta; tirooyinka ma aha shahaado ama naqshad la ogaaday.
wn.privacy: Shabakaddaadu waxay ku sii jirtaa mashruucan iyo kombiyuutarkan kaliya. Waxba looma diro meel kale.
wn.stopped: Waa la joojiyay hore: liistada waxay ka kooban tahay kaliya wixii la sameeyay.
wn.more: {n} safaf oo dheeraad ah ayaa ku jira CSV-ga.
wn.progress.nodes: Socodka dab-demiska: {done} ka mid ah {n} hidrant
wn.err.nonet: Mashruucan weli shabakad biyo ma leh. Marka hore isticmaal qalabka Tuubooyinka biyaha si aad u sawirto isku-xidhka, kaydka iyo tuubooyinka.
wn.err.noloads: Marka hore ku dhaji ugu yaraan hal xariiq oo baahi ah.
wn.err.trace_node: Dooro kaydka ama tangiga uu raadintu ka bilaabanto.
wn.err.not_configured: WaterCraft ma gaari karin xalinta biyaha. Bogga dib u cusboonaysii.
wn.dem.help: Macmiil kasta hal xariiq: aqoonsi, x, y, nooc, tiro. Nooca waa mid ka mid ah {kinds}, ama flow haddii aad socod la qoray. Tirada waa unug (guri), balaadhka (acre, ama hektar marka metric la isticmaalo) ama socod. Mid kasta waxa loo geeyaa isku-xidhka ugu dhow.
wn.dem.share: Wadaag baahi ka dhexeeya isku-xidhka ku dhow ilaa 300 ft (90 m)
wn.pat.keep: Qaabka ha ahaado sida uu yahay
wn.dem.starting: Isticmaalka guri kasta ama acre kasta waa qiime bilow, ma aha heer caadi ah. Ka beddel qiimayaasha naqshadeynta ee shirkadda biyaha kahor intaadan natiijada isku halayn.
wn.dem.result: Wadarta {total} {u} waxa ku jira {n} isku-xidhka; {bad} xariiq lama geyn karin.
wn.dem.applied: Baahiyaha waa lagu qoray tuubooyinka biyaha. Ka noqo ayaa dib u qaadaya.
wn.fire.help: Hidrant kasta (ama isku-xidhka kasta haddii aan la calaamadin): socodka uu bixin karo intii cadaadisku hadhaagga ku hayn lahaa, oo lagu helo isla xalinta daaqadda Tuubooyinka biyaha.
wn.fire.system: Meel kasta oo nidaamka ku jira (adag)
wn.fire.mult: Isku-dhufashada baahida (1 = baahida sida la sawiray; isticmaal caamilka maalinta ugu badan)
wn.fire.result: {pass} ka mid ah ayaa buuxinaya {needed} {q} ee {res} {p}; {fail} way ku yaraadaan.
wn.limit.base: cadaadis hoose ka hor inta aan biyo la qaadin
wn.limit.cap: ka badan intii raadintu isku dayday
wn.crit.help: Mid kasta oo tuubo ah wakhti-wakhti ka saara adeegga, oo mar kale xisaabi: inta baahi la gooyo iyo isku-xidhka cadaadiskoodu ka hooseeyo heerka ugu yar. Haddii fiilboollaha (valve) tuubooyinka lagu dhejiyay, qayb fiilboollaha leh oo dhan ayaa la ka saari karaa.
wn.crit.segment: hal qayb oo fiilboollaha leh mar
wn.crit.result: {n} joojin ayaa la isku dayay; {cut} ka mid ah ayaa macmiil qaarkood ka gooyay.
wn.q.help: Biyaha ayuu ku raacaa socodka 24 saac: da'daada, inta klooriin ka hadhay, ama meesha ay ka timid. Waxay isticmaashaa qaabka baahida iyo heerarka tangiyada ee Tuubooyinka biyaha.
wn.q.minc: Hadhaaga ugu yar ee la doonayo (mg/L)
wn.q.maxage: Biyaha ugu da'da weyn ee la doonayo (saacadood)
wn.q.result: {n} isku-xidhka ka baxsan xadka aad dejisay.
wn.q.limits: Burburka koowaad oo kaliya; tangi waa hal isku-dhafan oo mugga ah, weli saldhig kor-u-qaade ma jiro. Si aad u akhrisid maalinta ugu dambeysa, si dheer u socodsii ilaa qaabku ku celcelinayo.
